data.name: Nahran
data.gender_notes: Nahran is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘nahr’, meaning ‘gift’ or ‘grant’. In Islamic history, the name Nahran is associated with the Prophet Solomon (Sulayman), who was known for his generosity and the abundance of blessings he received. The name Nahran carries the meaning “Gift” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nahran usually hope their child will grow to embody gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing generosity and blessings from Allah.
data.etymology: Nahran belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gift.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nahran total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
